description: Dizzi is an alcohol-infused dessert restaurant franchise offered by USVI Dizzibrands, LLC, a U.S. Virgin Islands company headquartered in St. Thomas. Its restaurants serve boozy desserts — ice cream, sorbets, pops, pies and gelatin shots with up to 19.25% ABV — under the 'Lickable Liquors' concept. Per the May 2023 FDD, the initial fee is $50,000, the Item 7 estimated investment totals $94,500 to $411,000, royalties are 4% of gross sales with a 1% brand fund, and franchisees receive an exclusive 1-mile territory. The FDD discloses no financial performance representations and no outlet list; the initial term is 10 years for a traditional restaurant (5 years for limited service).
territoryDescription: Exclusive territory: 1-mile radius from the Franchised Location (FDD Item 12, p.20). Franchisee may sell to anyone from the Franchised Location or within the Dizzi-approved Delivery Area. No right to acquire additional franchises. Dizzi may establish other restaurants outside the Exclusive Area that may compete and can sell proprietary products anywhere. Item-20 outlet count: 0 disclosed (outlet section missing from FDD body).
